core_station.name: Orbital Core Station
core_station.seen_as: An open deck on a station in orbit. Earth turns below, the Milky Way is overhead, and a ring of the station turns slowly outside.

memory_cathedral.name: Memory Cathedral
memory_cathedral.seen_as: A marble hall open to the stars. Its walls are shelved with thousands of small lights, each keeping its own time.

workshop_bay.name: Engineering Workshop
workshop_bay.seen_as: A repair bay with its door open to space. A welding arm works, a crane runs on its rails, and Earth goes by outside.

mountain_observatory.name: Mountain Observatory
mountain_observatory.seen_as: A stone terrace on a mountain plateau at dawn, ringed by still water that holds the sky.

debug_bunker.name: Debug Bunker
debug_bunker.seen_as: A dim concrete bunker of server racks and old terminals, with scrolling logs and one strip light flickering.

fabrication_lab.name: Fabrication Lab
fabrication_lab.seen_as: A clean white lab where a printer builds a part and an arm sorts crates off a belt.

digital_matrix.name: Digital Matrix
digital_matrix.seen_as: A world that is only being computed: a glowing grid, wire-frame hills, towers of falling data and a drawn sun.

anomaly_void.name: Anomaly Void
anomaly_void.seen_as: A cracked deck drifting towards a black hole, its disc bright, debris spiralling in.

evidence_studio.name: Evidence Studio
evidence_studio.seen_as: A dim studio with a long wall of pinned sheets strung together with red thread, a projector changing slides.

forest_sanctuary.name: Forest Sanctuary
forest_sanctuary.seen_as: A timber deck among tall pines in morning mist, ferns moving at its edge.

ocean_platform.name: Ocean Platform
ocean_platform.seen_as: A rig at sea at sunset. The water moves and carries the colour of the sky.

deep_space.name: Deep Space Observatory
deep_space.seen_as: A platform beside a ringed gas giant, with moons and tumbling rocks drifting past.

arctic_aurora.name: Arctic Aurora
arctic_aurora.seen_as: A snowfield at night under the northern lights.

desert_observatory.name: Desert Observatory
desert_observatory.seen_as: Dunes under the Milky Way, with an observatory dome and a dish turning.

underwater_lab.name: Underwater Research Lab
underwater_lab.seen_as: A glass dome on the seabed, with kelp, shoals of fish and shafts of light from above.

eli_room.name: ELI's Room
eli_room.seen_as: Open ground under an open sky. Nothing is here but what ELI has made; the sky, the ground and the light are his to choose.
